description: Vectors for a machine's report to its estate's hub, over the relay or the local channel's machine.report (DEC-0132, DEC-0146), written by tools/vectors/machine-report.ts, never by hand. seal: sealMachineReport(report, context), context.ephemeral the hex ephemeral scalar; recipient.publicKey is the base64 uncompressed P-256 point. open: openMachineReport(sealed, context) with schemaValid the machine-report schema; context.own.privateKey is the base64 P-256 scalar; context.sender is the machine relayCallerTier named; context.held, when present, the report the hub holds for that machine; context.notAfter, when present, the body's signed iat (DEC-0146); a case with findings expects the opened report to carry those FAC-SEM codes, and an ok case without report opens the case's own report. accept: acceptMachineReport(report, context) with schemaValid the machine-report schema, the hub's reading of a report it opened or its own node answered over the local channel (MR-2, MR-4); context.machine is the sender relayCallerTier named or the hub's own machine id, context.held the report the hub holds for that machine, context.notAfter the body's iat or the hub's clock when its own node answered, a relay time (Z form) or the report is malformed; an ok case expects the case's own report. read: readMachineReport(sealed, context), openMachineReport then acceptMachineReport under one context (MR-4's whole reading, DEC-0146), the context as open's with notAfter required; an ok case expects the case's own report. A sealed report is HPKE base mode, suite [16, 1, 1], info the ASCII fabric-machine-report/1, the additional data the RFC 8785 UTF-8 bytes of {type, from, to, msgId, kem}, the plaintext the RFC 8785 form of the report; enc and ct are unpadded base64url.

open.name: the hub opens the report of the machine that sent it
a report newer than the one held replaces it
a report not after the one held is stale
a report naming another machine than the sender
sealed to another kem
copied into another body (another msgId)
a plaintext that is no report
a lease named twice is a semantic finding, not a refusal of the seal
an enc that is not a point on P-256
an at with a leap second, which the schema's date-time takes and RFC 3339 as strictTime reads does not
an at strictTime cannot read is malformed before the machine is compared
an at with a space for T, held or not
an at with a space for T, nothing held
an at with an offset is no relay time
an at with a lower-case t is no relay time
an at with ten fraction digits is no relay time
a report half a microsecond after the one held is newer
a report half a microsecond before the one held is stale
an at at the body's iat
an at within the millisecond of the body's iat, to a finer fraction, is not after it
an at after the body's iat
an at after the body's iat is malformed before the machine is compared
a notAfter the hub cannot read refuses rather than lets through

accept.name: the hub's own node answers its report
an opened report whose lease is named twice is dropped
an at with a space for T
an unreadable at from another machine is malformed, not wrong-machine
a node that answers another machine's report
a report not after the one held
a report after the one held replaces it
a held report accepted with an offset before DEC-0146 still makes a report not after it stale
a held report accepted with an offset before DEC-0146 is replaced by a newer one
a held report accepted with an offset and a sub-millisecond fraction is compared to the millisecond
a held report accepted with an offset near the year 10000 still guards
a notAfter written with an offset is no relay time and refuses
an at 0.9996 ms into notAfter's millisecond is not after it: times are truncated, never rounded
the hub's own node answers with an at after the hub's clock

read.name: the hub reads the report of the machine that sent it
a read with no notAfter refuses rather than skips the bound
a report after the one held replaces it
a report that opens and names a lease twice is dropped
a report that names a lease twice and another machine keeps open's answer
a report that names a lease twice and is not after the one held keeps open's answer
